tasks.original_prompt:
Closing the loop on this patient's anemia: when did the hemoglobin first drop low this time, was it repeated, and where is it now?
Context: patient MRN SYN-43ee72545a (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2023-10-15, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order. A result is low when its value is below 12.0 g/dL for a patient whose Patient.gender is female and below 13.0 g/dL otherwise. answer is {"low": ..., "rechecked": ..., "recheck": ..., "recheck_ordered": ..., "latest": ..., "still_low": ...}. low is the first result of the most recent run of consecutive low results, with exactly these keys: date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit). rechecked (boolean) is whether any result is dated after low. recheck is the first result after low (same keys), and recheck_ordered (YYYY-MM-DD) the authoredOn date of the ServiceRequest its basedOn references; both null when not rechecked. latest is the most recent result (same keys) and still_low (boolean) whether it is low. Every field is null when no result is low. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (low, the recheck and its ServiceRequest, and latest; when no result is low, every hemoglobin result considered), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.

The eligibility check is the CoverageEligibilityResponse whose servicedDate equals the lab visit's start date. answer is {"visit_date": ..., "in_force": ..., "clinician": ..., "alerted": ...}: visit_date (YYYY-MM-DD), in_force (boolean: the response's first insurance entry's inforce) and clinician (string: that Practitioner's name text, or its given names and family name joined by spaces). tasks.original_prompt:
If this patient's most recent hemoglobin is still low, put a follow-up task on that lab report; if it has recovered, leave the chart alone.
Context: patient MRN SYN-43ee72545a (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2023-09-28, treated as today.

Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order. Context: patient MRN SYN-43ee72545a (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2023-09-13, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The last follow-up visit is the most recent Encounter with status finished, a type coding with code followup-coordination and a period start on or before the as-of date; call its start date the visit date. answer is {"visit_date": ..., "new_results": [...], "new_orders": [...]}. new_results has one entry for every Observation with status final or corrected, a code.coding code in this list: 718-7, 4548-4, 2160-0, 3016-3, 35200-5, 35217-9, and an effective date after the visit date and on or before the as-of date, sorted by date then code, each with exactly these keys: code (string), date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit). new_orders has one entry for every ServiceRequest authored after the visit date and on or before the as-of date, sorted by ordered then code, each with exactly these keys: code (string: first code.coding code), ordered (string: authoredOn date, YYYY-MM-DD) and status (string). evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the Encounter, each listed Observation and each listed ServiceRequest), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.
tasks.prompt:
For patient MRN SYN-43ee72545a, tell me the date of the most recent follow-up visit and list any lab results that came back and any new orders placed since that visit up to 2023-09-13.
Reply with only JSON: {"answer": {new_orders: list of {code: text, ordered: date YYYY-MM-DD, status: text}, new_results: list of {code: text, date: date YYYY-MM-DD, unit: text, value: number}, visit_date: date YYYY-MM-DD}, "evidence": [references of the records you used, Type/id]}. Use null for any value the chart does not have.
